title: Tahsildar performing quasi-judicial functions is 'judge'; protected from action for bona fide errors: MP High Court
description: Tahsildars performing quasi-judicial functions are "judges" under the Judges (Protection) Act, 1985 and are protected from disciplinary action for bona fide errors committed in that capacity, the Madhya Pradesh High Court recently held [DK Kamthan v.
